adjustments: Every waiting fixture issue is born with status:needs-human in the fake GitHub state, so this probe issues no status write. The V4-2 probe flipped issue 1 to needs-human through the UI, which V4-3 now refuses without an artifact; that refusal is covered by web/tests/v4-3-human-review.test.mjs and is not re-exercised here.

The image artifact URL (https://example.com/screenshots/login-empty.png) is fulfilled by a Playwright route with a synthetic 320x200 PNG, so the inline render and its natural width are measured without network access. The URL in the issue body is not rewritten and the parser still sees the https URL.
The legacy and malformed states deliberately carry a body the V4-3 parser refuses, because the point of those states is the precise reason shown to the reader.
